messages.author: Pedro Miguel Reis Figueiredo
messages.body:
I am trying to perform interpolated corrections following the theory
presented in this article: doi.org/10.1021/jp049633g to correct PMFs
calculated with PM3/MM.
For what I have understood, I must implement a spline function as an
additional potential term to perform the MD with umbrella sampling
(equations 12 and 13). How can I add this additional potential to AMBER?
Thank you in advance!
